
  Every route of /v1/products asks the access policy for `products:read` or
  `products:write` first; src/adapters/http/api_access.rs explains the
  deny-by-default choice.
  The JSON API takes the bearer tokens of POST /auth/login:

    curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/v1/products -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"


  Then: forge migrate, and forge dev (or forge test).

declare src/domain/entities/mod.rs (pub mod product;)
//! Entities: domain objects with identity and invariants.

pub mod product;

declare src/application/ports/mod.rs (pub mod product_repository;)
//! Ports: traits implemented by adapters and infrastructure.

pub mod product_repository;

declare src/application/use_cases/mod.rs (pub mod products;)
//! Use cases: orchestration and transaction boundaries.

pub mod products;

declare src/infrastructure/database/mod.rs (pub mod products;)
//! PostgreSQL infrastructure: least-privilege tenant transaction setup.

pub mod products;

use forge::tenancy::TenantContext;
use sqlx::{PgPool, Postgres, Transaction};

/// Starts a PostgreSQL transaction and installs tenant/principal settings only
/// for that transaction.
///
/// RLS policies should read these values with current_setting(..., true). The
/// third set_config argument is true, so pooled connections do not retain tenant
/// identity after commit/rollback.
pub async fn begin_tenant_transaction<'a>(
    pool: &'a PgPool,
    context: &TenantContext,
) -> Result<Transaction<'a, Postgres>, sqlx::Error> {
    let mut transaction = pool.begin().await?;

    sqlx::query(
        "SELECT set_config('forge.tenant_id', $1, true), \
         set_config('forge.principal_id', $2, true)",
    )
    .bind(context.tenant_id().to_string())
    .bind(context.principal_id().to_string())
    .execute(&mut *transaction)
    .await?;

    Ok(transaction)
}

declare src/adapters/http/mod.rs (pub mod api_access; pub mod products_api;)
//! HTTP adapter. Handlers stay thin: decode the request, call a use case and
//! map the result to a response, usually an HTML page rendered from a view
//! model in `views` (or a `303` redirect after a form submission).

pub mod api_access;
pub mod api_authentication;
pub mod authentication;
pub mod products_api;
pub mod status;
pub mod views;

use std::sync::Arc;

use forge::ComposeError;
use forge::http::{Method, Request, Response, Router};
use forge::i18n::Translator;

use self::views::{Site, welcome::WelcomeIndex};

/// Whether the welcome page links to the sign-in pages.
const SIGN_IN: bool = true;

/// Loads the site and registers the digested assets and the request layers
/// every HTML page relies on (the request's locale, Content-Security-Policy,
/// CSRF protection with the `_method` override, flash messages). Every page
/// renders its layout from the returned site; `translator` is
/// `views::locales::translator(config)`.
pub fn site(router: &mut Router, translator: Translator) -> Result<Arc<Site>, ComposeError> {
    let site = Arc::new(Site::load(translator)?);
    site.register(router).map_err(ComposeError::other)?;
    Ok(site)
}

/// Registers the application's routes. Forge adds `/health`, `/health/live`
/// and `/health/ready` itself.
pub fn routes(router: &mut Router, site: &Arc<Site>) -> Result<(), ComposeError> {
    let index_site = Arc::clone(site);
    router.route(Method::GET, "/", move |request: Request| {
        let site = Arc::clone(&index_site);
        async move { index(&site, &request) }
    })?;
    status::routes(router)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn index(site: &Site, request: &Request) -> Response {
    forge::web::html(&WelcomeIndex {
        layout: site.layout(request),
        logo: site.logo(),
        application: env!("CARGO_PKG_NAME"),
        sign_in: SIGN_IN,
    })
}

wire src/bootstrap/routes_gen.rs (resource products)
// forge:checksum ee802c308bc05d0c7906e1639fc801ffd93f35f86cd4c1292a63bb949aabe883
//! Routes the generators mount. `forge generate scaffold`, `forge generate
//! resource` and `forge generate controller` write this file, and `forge
//! destroy` takes their blocks back out; each block starts with a `forge:`
//! comment. Do not edit it: the generators refuse to change it once its
//! checksum no longer matches. Mount your own routes in `compose`
//! (src/bootstrap/mod.rs), which calls this function once.

/// Mounts the routes of the generated resources and controllers.
pub(super) fn generated_routes(
    composition: &mut forge::Composition<'_>,
    _site: &std::sync::Arc<crate::adapters::http::views::Site>,
) -> Result<(), forge::ComposeError> {
    // forge:resource products
    {
        let products =
            crate::application::use_cases::products::ProductService::new(std::sync::Arc::new(
                crate::infrastructure::database::products::PgProductRepository::new(
                    composition.postgres()?.clone(),
                ),
            ));
        // products JSON API (/v1/products): tenant-scoped. The bearer token of
        // POST /auth/login names the tenant; RBAC denies every role `policy` does
        // not name: the `owner` role (`forge setup` gives it to the first member) may
        // read and write.
        let mut policy = forge::security::RbacPolicy::new();
        let owner = forge::security::Role::new("owner").map_err(forge::ComposeError::other)?;
        for permission in [
            crate::application::use_cases::products::READ_PERMISSION,
            crate::application::use_cases::products::WRITE_PERMISSION,
        ] {
            let permission =
                forge::security::Permission::new(permission).map_err(forge::ComposeError::other)?;
            policy.allow(owner.clone(), permission);
        }
        let pool = composition.postgres()?.pool().clone();
        // Tokens end after FORGE_AUTH_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT without a request.
        let bearer_sessions =
            crate::infrastructure::bearer_sessions::PostgresBearerSessionStore::new(pool.clone())
                .with_idle_timeout(
                    forge::auth::SessionIdleTimeout::new(
                        composition.config().auth.session_idle_timeout,
                    )
                    .map_err(forge::ComposeError::other)?,
                );
        crate::adapters::http::products_api::routes(
            composition.router(),
            products,
            std::sync::Arc::new(crate::adapters::http::api_access::BearerTenantAccess::new(
                std::sync::Arc::new(bearer_sessions),
                std::sync::Arc::new(crate::infrastructure::tenancy::PgMembershipStore::new(pool)),
                policy,
            )),
        )?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
